name: Barbell Good Morning
steps: Rest a light barbell on your upper back as you would for a squat.
Stand with feet hip width and knees slightly bent.
Push hips back and bow forward with a flat back.
Stop at a hamstring stretch, at or above parallel to the floor.
Drive hips forward to stand back up.
cues: Breathe in down, breathe out as you rise

common_mistakes.mistake: Rounding the back at the bottom
common_mistakes.fix: Stop higher, where your back stays flat
Use a light load; this is a technique lift
Keep the knee bend small and fixed
